description: EX-RACE (needs a pause inside an open). Process a signals and calls OpenDatabase of the big fixture exclusive read/write; b suspends a 5 ms after the signal (b records whether a had returned with a 50 ms Await), then tries OpenDatabase shared read/write and exclusive (Errors before/after) and a native read share-read handle while a is frozen; b resumes a; a reports its own open result and reads the row count; b tries again after a closes. Asks whether a half-finished exclusive open is already visible to a second opener, whether the second opener or the first wins, and what the loser's answer is.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
